name: uv-index
title: UV Index
description: See the current UV index for your city or town at a glance, in root search or the menu bar.
author: samuel_ford_sam_ford

commands.name: uv-index
commands.title: UV Index
commands.description: Shows the current UV index for your city or town. The last reading stays visible next to the command in search.

commands.name: menu-bar-uv
commands.title: UV Index in Menu Bar
commands.description: Pins a minimal sun icon with the current UV index to the menu bar.

preferences.name: city
preferences.title: City or Town
preferences.description: Where to show the UV index for. Add a country or state to be specific, e.g. "Perth, Scotland".

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
